mutants.description: Student error: A whole number given as digit text is converted and accepted.
Student error: The actual unit count of flexible_budget accepts digit text and converts it.
Student error: Flexed amounts rounded up to the next cent, not to the nearest.
Student error: A product name that is a number is accepted, because only emptiness is checked.
Student error: The products may be given as a mapping of product mappings, read by its values.
Student error: A budget with one budgeted unit in total is refused as having no budget.
Student error: A product with no actual units still contributes one unit to the price variance.
Student error: Sales volume variance taken as master profit less flexed profit, the wrong sign.
Student error: A zero fixed overhead is refused: the check treats zero as not positive.
Student error: A product with zero standard inputs per unit is refused as having no input.
Student error: a product name given as the boolean True is accepted as text.
Student error: a case given as a list of (field, value) pairs is converted to a dict and accepted.
Student error: products with equal budgeted margins are refused as a tie, though a tie has no mix variance.
Student error: the case is refused unless it is exactly a dict, so a valid read-only Mapping is refused.
Student error: a negative actual unit count passed to flexible_budget is clamped to zero, not refused.
Student error: a whole-number field given as nothing (None) is read as zero, not refused.
Student error: a product that is nothing (None) in the product list is skipped instead of refused.
Student error: products given as a tuple of mappings are accepted as if they were a list.
Student error: zero input units used is refused as if no inputs were used, which is a valid case.
Student error: a product sold in zero units in the actual period is refused, though zero units is valid.
Student error: flexible_budget reports zero fixed cost, though its profit still deducts the overhead.
Student error: a product name is converted with str(), so a number, None or a boolean is accepted as a name.
Student error: the sales price variance is budget price less actual price, so a price rise is unfavourable.
Student error: a products value of None is not checked, so iterating it raises a TypeError, not a ValueError.
Student error: a case with one product is refused, because the student read 'more than one' into the rule.
Student error: master_budget returns the total units as a float, which equals the integer in value only.
Student error: the flexed variable cost rounds a half cent down, not up.
Student error: an actual price of zero is refused, though an unsold or free unit is a valid case.
Student error: a budgeted price of zero is refused, though zero is a valid price.
Student error: with zero actual units the flexed profit is taken as zero, forgetting the fixed overhead.
Student error: flexible_budget reads True as one unit, because a bool is an int, instead of refusing it.
Student error: the flexed revenue is rounded product by product and the rounded parts are added.
Student error: the sales mix variance is reported as its size, so an unfavourable mix shows as positive.
Student error: the sales mix is computed from the exact flexed profit and truncated to a whole cent.
Student error: a negative fixed overhead is accepted, because only the sign of the other fields is checked.
Student error: a negative actual unit count on a product is clamped to zero instead of refused.
Student error: the sales price variance keeps only the favourable price changes, so a price fall is dropped.
Student error: a case in which no input unit was used is refused, although zero is a valid count.
Student error: the budgeted margin per unit is computed for every product, so a product with no budgeted units divides by zero.
Student error: a product whose standard input count is zero is refused, although a product may use no input.
Student error: a duplicate name is checked only against the previous product, so a repeat of the first name is accepted.
Student error: a first product with zero budgeted units is refused; only a zero total budget should be refused.
Student error: a boolean budgeted unit count in the last product is accepted as 1 or 0.
Student error: a field missing from the last product is read as zero, not refused.
Student error: the name check is skipped for the last product, so an empty last name is accepted.
Student error: a negative actual unit count is refused for every product except the last.
Student error: a last product that is not a mapping is silently skipped instead of refused.
Student error: the name check is skipped for the middle product, so an empty middle name is accepted.
Student error: a float budgeted price in the middle product is truncated to whole cents, not refused.
Student error: only the first product's numbers are validated; a later product's count is used as given.
Student error: a float actual unit count is truncated to an int for every product after the first, not refused.
Student error: a negative budget price is accepted for every product after the first.
Student error: a boolean actual price is read as 0 or 1 for every product after the first, not refused.
Student error: a product after the first with no budget_units field is read as budgeting zero units.
Student error: a negative standard input count is accepted for every product after the first.
Student error: variance_decomposition reads a boolean actual input count as 0 or 1; the other functions refuse it.
Student error: an empty product list is accepted and gives zero budgeted profit, not a ValueError.
Student error: a case with no fixed_overhead_cents field is read as zero fixed overhead.
Student error: flexible_budget does not refuse two products with the same name; master_budget and variance_decomposition do.
Student error: a None actual unit count on a product after the first is read as zero units, not refused.
Mix variance omitted: the mix contribution is folded into the sales price variance, so sales_mix is zero.
Flexed budget built from budgeted rather than actual total units, so the volume variance uses the wrong volume.
Efficiency sign flipped: using fewer inputs than the standard allows is charged as unfavourable.
Mix contribution uses each product's per-unit margin, not the margin times the actual units.
Flexed amounts truncated toward zero instead of rounded to the nearest cent, halves up.
No zero-budget guard: a case with no budgeted units is accepted by master_budget and fails with ZeroDivisionError in flexible_budget.
Empty product name accepted: the case validation checks only that the name is a string.
Efficiency uses the budgeted units for the standard inputs instead of the actual output.
Booleans accepted as whole numbers: the bool exclusion in the whole-number check is dropped.
Sales price variance multiplies the price difference by budgeted units instead of actual units.
Flexed profit rounded once from the exact fraction instead of rounding revenue and variable cost first.
Duplicate product names accepted by master_budget and flexible_budget: only variance_decomposition rejects them.
Sales mix variance rounded from the exact flexed profit instead of using the whole-cent flexed profit.
Flexed amounts rounded to the nearest cent with ties going down, not halves up.
Negative actual input count accepted: the actual inputs are checked as whole numbers only.
flexible_budget takes a float actual-units count and truncates it instead of refusing it.
Negative actual units of a product accepted: the field is checked as a whole number only.
Negative fixed overhead accepted: the field is checked as a whole number only.
Negative actual price accepted: the field is checked as a whole number only.
Integral floats accepted as whole numbers (2000.0 read as 2000): the float refusal is dropped for integral values.
Missing product field defaults to zero instead of raising ValueError.
Negative budget price accepted: the budget price is checked as a whole number only.
Negative standard inputs per unit accepted: the field is checked as a whole number only.
Missing input price defaults to zero instead of raising ValueError.
Missing actual_inputs_used defaults to zero instead of raising ValueError.
master_budget silently replaces a negative input price with zero instead of raising ValueError.
master_budget returns the same cached object on every call instead of a fresh one.
A debug print is left in flexible_budget, so it writes to stdout.
master_budget adds a key to the caller case, so it changes its argument.
Input price accepted as a fraction and truncated: 200.5 cents is read as 200 cents, with no error.
Actual input units accepted as a fraction and truncated: 5300.5 is read as 5300, with no error.
A product actual units accepted as a fraction and truncated: 1199.6 units is read as 1199 units, with no error.
Fixed overhead accepted as a fraction and truncated: 2000000.75 cents is read as 2000000 cents, with no error.
master_budget sorts the caller's products list by name in place, so it changes its argument when names are unsorted.
Product fields accept a boolean as a whole number: the bool exclusion is dropped on the product path only. Reference solution for the AC4 budget and variance engine (budget_engine.py).
flexible_budget accepts a boolean actual-units argument: True is read as one unit, with no error. Reference solution for the AC4 budget and variance engine (budget_engine.py).
master_budget issues a UserWarning on every call: the grader sees it only when run with warnings as errors. Reference solution for the AC4 budget and variance engine (budget_engine.py).
flexible_budget rounds the budgeted revenue and variable cost per unit to the nearest cent before it scales them to the actual units.
The boolean refusal for actual_inputs_used is applied only in master_budget; flexible_budget and variance_decomposition accept True as one input unit.
Only master_budget refuses a budget with no budgeted units; flexible_budget returns zero revenue and cost instead of raising ValueError.
Mix contribution priced at the budgeted units, not the actual units, so the mix line uses the budget mix twice.
